items.description: Diagnostic inspection of the cracked laptop
items.rationale: Battery report shows full charge capacity 41,200/52,000 mWh = 79%, below 80%; per 2.6.8 the unit is no longer insured equipment, no battery waiver (standard form), so 2.6.7 bars all heads incl. examination under 5.2.3.

items.description: Laptop screen and lower-right corner repair
items.rationale: 2.6.8 end-of-working-life rule (79% < 80% design capacity, established by shop examination) removes the unit from cover whatever the cause; 2.6.7 then excludes repair.
